claim_guardrail: Can be framed as a leading candidate axis, but only as validated mechanism after formal communication, protein, and perturbation evidence.
synovial_fluid_targets: MIF, soluble CD74 if available, macrophage chemokines
perturbation_strategy: anti-MIF or ISO-1; CD74 blockade as a receptor-side sensitivity test
primary_readouts: IL6, CXCL8, MMP3, MMP13, NF-kB/STAT3 targets, senescence/SASP markers
risk_note: CD74 is strongest in immune cells; tissue contamination and immune-cell abundance must be separated from paracrine activation.

claim_guardrail: Can be framed as a leading candidate axis, but only as validated mechanism after formal communication, protein, and perturbation evidence.
synovial_fluid_targets: ANGPTL4 plus matrix-remodeling proteins and integrin-associated ECM fragments
perturbation_strategy: anti-ANGPTL4, ITGB1 blocking antibody, ITGAV blocking antibody, or RGD/integrin competition control
primary_readouts: tube formation, endothelial migration, COL1A1/COL3A1/FN1, MMPs, cell adhesion, ECM remodeling

claim_guardrail: Can be framed as a leading candidate axis, but only as validated mechanism after formal communication, protein, and perturbation evidence.
synovial_fluid_targets: VEGFA, soluble FLT1 if available, angiogenesis panel proteins
perturbation_strategy: anti-VEGFA or VEGFR inhibitor; include endothelial viability control
primary_readouts: tube formation, endothelial migration, KDR/FLT1 targets, ANGPT2, IL6, MMPs
risk_note: VEGF is biologically strong but not meniscus-specific; tie it back to MSP-high cell states and joint-fluid protein evidence.

claim_guardrail: Use as secondary mechanism; require receptor/pathway validation before causal language.
synovial_fluid_targets: MIF, CXCL12, CCL2, CXCL8 and matched chemokine panel proteins
perturbation_strategy: CXCR4 antagonist AMD3100, CXCR2 antagonist, CCR2 antagonist, or ligand-neutralizing antibody matched to the axis
primary_readouts: cell migration, IL6/CXCL8/CCL2 secretion, NF-kB targets, macrophage activation markers
risk_note: Chemokine receptors can be sparse in dissociated single-cell data; use protein and functional migration evidence before strong claims.
